Query: which unit of area does the measurement system that have an electric field strength units of volt per metre have?
Rationale: The Candidate's query structure is invalid according to SQUALL grammar. It attempts to use the English question form 'Which [NP] does [NP] [verb]?' (e.g., 'Which unit does the system have?'). In SQUALL, a 'Which' question must follow the 'S ?' rule where 'S' is 'NP VP'. The 'NP' would be 'Which <unit> of <area>', but the remaining 'does the <measurement system> ... have' is not a valid 'VP' because a 'VP' cannot contain its own subject ('the <measurement system> ...'). A correct SQUALL version would be 'Which <unit> of <area> is the <unit> of the <measurement system> that has <electric field strength units> <volt per metre>?' or 'Does the <measurement system> that has <electric field strength units> <volt per metre> have a <unit> of <area>?'.
